Steps to get the videoUrl:
- Open discord.
- Upload the video you want ('.mp4').
- Once the video uploaded, hold/right click the video & click at 'Copy Media Link'/'Copy Link'.
- Then paste it into the MediaPlayer Gui.
(Sometimes, the videoUrl copied is not '.mp4', so you need play it on your device to check, is it showing video '.mp4' or not showing but only audio '.mp3 but saved as .mp4')
(The saving process are very slow & will lag your device)
(it takes some times to load the video into the playlist)

(If you delete your video file, make sure to click the button that you deleted in the MediaPlayer Gui, so it will removed the button too)

highlight = highlight .. c
elseif quote == false then
highlight = highlight .. "\32"
end
end)

end

local comments = function(string)
local ret = ""
string:gsub("[^\r\n]+", function(c)
local comm = false
local i = 0
c:gsub(".", function(n)
i = i + 1
if c:sub(i, i + 1) == "--" then
comm = true
end
if comm == true then
ret = ret .. n
else
ret = ret .. "\32"
end
end)
ret = ret
end)

return ret
end

local numbers = function(string)
local A = ""
string:gsub(".", function(c)
if tonumber(c) ~= nil then
A = A .. c
elseif c == "\n" then
A = A .. "\n"
elseif c == "\t" then
A = A .. "\t"
else
A = A .. "\32"
end
end)

return A
end

src.Text = Source.Text:gsub("\13", "")

src.Strings_.Text = strings(s)
local lin = 1
s:gsub("\n", function()
lin = lin + 1
end)
Lines.Text = ""
for i = 1, lin do
Lines.Text = Lines.Text .. i .. "\n"
end
end
end
